entries.displayName: Video compressor for Discord upload limits
entries.description: Browser-side tool that re-encodes a video to a chosen target size (10, 25, 50, 100, 500 MB or custom) and returns an H.264 MP4. Nothing is uploaded.
representativeQueries: make a video under 10 mb for discord
